title: Conditional Branching Dialogue Runtime
description: Implement dialogue nodes, conditional responses, state-changing consequences, and conversation termination without UI dependencies.
requirements: A node must support multiple player responses.
Unavailable responses must include a reason for debugging.
Consequences must be applied only after a response is selected.
Dialogue data must remain separate from presentation.
Invalid node references must terminate gracefully with an error result.
constraint: Random number generation must be supplied through an abstraction.
stretchGoal: Add save and load support without coupling serialisation to the core system.
